summary: Sanskar Mittal is a finance and accounts professional with 8+ years of experience in bookkeeping, month-end close, accounts receivable and payable, MIS reporting, budgeting, forecasting and financial modeling for SaaS, service, eCommerce and product businesses. He is a Partner at Renocrew Solutions and a QuickBooks ProAdvisor, and works with clients on Upwork (100% Job Success). Based in Dhanbad, India; works remotely with clients worldwide.

about.heading: The Books First. Then the Plan.
paragraphs: I've spent 8+ years in finance and accounts: bookkeeping, monthly closes, financial statements, AR and AP, and the MIS reports, budgets and forecasts that management uses to make decisions. I've worked across SaaS, service, eCommerce and product businesses.

I'm a Partner at Renocrew Solutions and a QuickBooks ProAdvisor, and I work with clients on Upwork, where I have a 100% Job Success Score. Before that, as a Senior Executive in Finance & Accounts at Verve Advisory, I led a team of 25, built budgeting and forecasting models, and moved a client's books from Zoho to QuickBooks with minimal disruption.
about.note: Based in Dhanbad, India · Working remotely with clients worldwide

services.title: Bookkeeping & Month-End Close
services.body: Day-to-day bookkeeping, bank and credit card reconciliations, and a month-end close that's accurate, compliant and on time.

services.title: MIS Reporting

services.title: Migrations & Virtual CFO

faqs.q: Which accounting software do you work in?
faqs.a: QuickBooks Online (I'm a QuickBooks ProAdvisor), Xero, Oracle NetSuite, Zoho Books, Tally, SAP, Accounting Seed and Yardi, with reporting and models built in Microsoft Excel.

faqs.q: Can you catch up books that were never kept?
faqs.a: Yes. I've reconciled a full year of an eCommerce business's books from scratch, and AR cleanups and catch-ups are a regular part of my work.

faqs.q: Do you work with eCommerce sellers?
faqs.a: Yes. I reconcile Amazon and Shopify sales through A2X, and Stripe and PayPal payouts to the bank.

faqs.q: What does your FP&A and virtual CFO support include?
faqs.a: Budgets aligned to your goals, forecasting and financial models, monthly MIS reports on cash flow, profit and loss and the balance sheet, and cash flow management and advice.

faqs.q: Where are you based, and do you work remotely?
faqs.a: I'm based in Dhanbad, India (IST, UTC+5:30) and work remotely with clients worldwide, over video calls and inside your own accounting systems.
